text:
Asking rents in Mettmann district stand at a median of 10.80 €/m² (2026-06), up 6.2% on the year and +25.6% over five years. That ranks Mettmann district #22 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 50% above the 2022 average contract rent of 7.21 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 648 € a month in cold rent, 12.5% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 29 days and 24% are gone within a week; with 1.6% market-active vacancy and +0.9% population growth over five years, the market looks broadly balanced.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 11.31 €/m² (+4.7%), with an 80% range of 11.00 to 11.56 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
